verdict.rationale: Discord documents two first-party credential types: bot tokens and OAuth2 bearer tokens issued through a registered developer application (discord-docs-4, discord-docs-6, discord-docs-17). OAuth2 scope descriptions, such as one granting access to /users/@me/connections (discord-docs-27), show tokens can be limited to specific data. However, the pack never shows least-privilege scoping for bot tokens or any agent-oriented credential issuance. Missing for 10: documented bot permission/role scoping, a fine-grained scope reference, token restriction and revocation controls, agent-specific credential guidance, and independent corroboration.
